heading: Error model
text:
### Error model [IRET.28.12]

`oa` uses `ds_result_t` per the libds convention (NERR.1 / IERR). The
codes are existing taxonomy members — `oa` introduces no new code:

| Code | Condition |
|---|---|
| `DS_OK_R` | success. |
| `DS_ERR_OOM` | allocation failed (grow/reserve); structure unchanged. |
| `DS_ERR_RT_UNSAFE` | a grow would be required while `locked`; structure unchanged. |
